**What we're giving them**
- **Loomly:** an $18,400 credit, equal to its full November platform fees. It goes on the December invoice as a credit memo, with no cash [5][2]. Carla confirmed this to Loomly in the ticket [1].
- **Pinecrest:** a $6,200 credit, equal to its full November platform fees, also on the December invoice. Rachel emailed this to Grant Holloway [8].
- **Total:** $24,600. This replaced the 50% offer first floated on Nov 12 [5].

**Still open for Loomly:** Loomly says 214 sellers paid $7,690 in overdraft fees. Marcus and Rachel are deciding whether to cover them, and Loomly was promised an answer by Nov 25 [1]. Nothing I found shows a decision. Marcus's draft note says Loomly "has also req…", and the excerpt cuts off there, so I can't tell how it ends [2].

**Is it in the November books?**
- **Planned:** Marcus said on Nov 13 that he would accrue it in the November close [5]. His draft journal entry accrues $24,600 as contra-revenue, to be reversed when the credit memos are issued [2].
- **Not confirmed as posted:** The Nov 16 close checklist lists the service credits accrual as "In progress" and assigns it to Marcus [7]. On Nov 17 he was still asking how to book it [2]. I found nothing showing the entry has been posted.
- **Overdraft fees:** The $7,690 is not in the accrual, because no decision has been made on it [1][2].
